description: The canonical workflow skeletons (chain · gate-and-act · fanout · …). Without `name`: the list. With `name`: that skeleton's source. Fill value slots and check it. With `filled: true` and an exact name: the runnable lesson generated from that skeleton, when available.

filled.description: Return the paired filled lesson instead of the skeleton. Requires an exact name; missing pairs fail explicitly.

name.description: A template name from the list (e.g. `chain`).
